purpose: Select among exactly three H_Q_CV values for development-only kinematic accuracy checks.

training.winner_rule: Among candidates meeting every training gate, choose lowest pooled nominal post-initialization position RMS; exact ties choose lower H_Q_CV, then setting_id lexical order.
training.case_allocation: Each of 3 H_Q_CV candidates × 3 seeds × (six v1 scenarios plus onset-exit) is paired with frozen default on byte-identical inputs.

development_check.purpose: development stability check only; never used to retune or select another winner
development_check.clarification: Run the selected candidate and frozen-default H_Q_CV=1 control on the same check inputs; no other experimental H_Q_CV settings may be run.
development_check.case_allocation: One selected candidate × 3 seeds × six v1 scenarios plus onset-exit, each paired with frozen default on identical inputs; no other candidate value.

trajectory.post_turn_motion: straight at 150 m/s on final heading
trajectory.turn_direction: mirrored by numeric flight ID parity: even s=+1, odd s=-1
trajectory.formula: q=s*w*(t-60); x=x0+9000+(150/(s*w))*sin(q), y=y0+(150/(s*w))*(1-cos(q)); after120 continue linearly at exit position/velocity

onset-exit.censored_lag: reported as right-censored at response-window end; never assigned zero or dropped

turn_lag.censored_crossing: fails response guard; report as right-censored at 30s

uncertainty.basis: candidate output covariance in candidate local ENU axes
uncertainty.score: 2D posterior Mahalanobis containment of paired post-initialization horizontal errors
uncertainty.nis_reason: pre-gate public API does not expose NIS

bootstrap.method: hierarchical paired cluster bootstrap: sample seed blocks with replacement, then sample whole flights within each selected seed with replacement; retain each selected flight’s full row/ping block
bootstrap.pass_rule: 95% bootstrap lower bound meets each containment floor

uncertainty.grouping: Pool the three training seeds separately for each nominal scenario; for onset-exit, separately for every direction × transition-window group. Each per-case report stores per-(seed,flight) containment counts/successes for cohort aggregation.
uncertainty.floors_apply_to: every preregistered nominal scenario and each onset-exit direction/response-window group
uncertainty.terminology: undercoverage guard, not a complete calibration proof

analysis.position_frame: candidate local ENU for covariance; evaluator WGS84 horizontal error for paired benchmark metrics
analysis.missing_policy: retain full-grid coverage and missing/cold-start rows; do not impute errors
analysis.cross_scenario_confidence_intervals: not claimed from this small development study
analysis.selection_rule: All hard gates pass, then choose lowest pooled nominal post-initialization position RMS; exact ties choose lower H_Q_CV then lexical setting_id.

native_regression_guard.run_for: each of the three candidate settings before winner selection
native_regression_guard.failure_rule: missing evidence or nonzero exit makes setting ineligible
native_regression_guard.selected_candidate_followup: run full oa-track core suite; it cannot change the preselected candidate
